Hello: there

I am trying to build an point referenced zero inflation binomial model.The error is :
GMRFLib_2order_approx: rescue NAN/INF values in logl for idx=3
GMRFLib_2order_approx: rescue NAN/INF values in logl for idx=10
GMRFLib_2order_approx: rescue NAN/INF values in logl for idx=11

GMRFLib_2order_approx: rescue NAN/INF values in logl for idx=24
GMRFLib_2order_approx: rescue NAN/INF values in logl for idx=25
GMRFLib_2order_approx: rescue NAN/INF values in logl for idx=30
GMRFLib_2order_approx: rescue NAN/INF values in logl for idx=31
GMRFLib_2order_approx: rescue NAN/INF values in logl for idx=37
GMRFLib_2order_approx: rescue NAN/INF values in logl for idx=39
inla.mkl: tabulate-Qfunc.c:147: GMRFLib_tabulate_Qfunc_core: Assertion `arg->Q->a[0] >= 0.0' failed.
sh: line 1: 315644 Segmentation fault   

Whether i add "safe=TRUE" in inla(), it will crash down

Kind regards

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] error: GMRFLib_2order_approx: rescue NAN/INF values in logl for idx=
parts:
I would try with

r=inla(..., control.inla=list(cmin=0))

r$.args$control.inla$cmin <- -Inf
r = inla.rerun(r)

usually this make solve the issue.

the zero-inflated ones are not log-concave in all parameters, hence the
issue...

Best
H
